类 Location

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.Location

    • setYaw

      public void setYaw(float yaw)
      Sets the yaw of this location, measured in degrees. 设置此位置的偏航角（yaw），以度为单位。
      • A yaw of 0 or 360 represents the positive z direction. 偏航角 0 或 360 表示正 z 方向。
      • A yaw of 180 represents the negative z direction. 偏航角 180 表示负 z 方向。
      • A yaw of 90 represents the negative x direction. 偏航角 90 表示负 x 方向。
      • A yaw of 270 represents the positive x direction. 偏航角 270 表示正 x 方向。
      Increasing yaw values are the equivalent of turning to your right-facing, increasing the scale of the next respective axis, and decreasing the scale of the previous axis. 偏航角增大相当于向右转，即下一个相应轴的刻度增大、前一个轴的刻度减小。
      参数:
      yaw - new rotation's yaw 新朝向的偏航角

    • getYaw

      public float getYaw()
      Gets the yaw of this location, measured in degrees. 获取此位置的偏航角（yaw），以度为单位。
      • A yaw of 0 or 360 represents the positive z direction. 偏航角 0 或 360 表示正 z 方向。
      • A yaw of 180 represents the negative z direction. 偏航角 180 表示负 z 方向。
      • A yaw of 90 represents the negative x direction. 偏航角 90 表示负 x 方向。
      • A yaw of 270 represents the positive x direction. 偏航角 270 表示正 x 方向。
      Increasing yaw values are the equivalent of turning to your right-facing, increasing the scale of the next respective axis, and decreasing the scale of the previous axis. 偏航角增大相当于向右转，即下一个相应轴的刻度增大、前一个轴的刻度减小。
      返回:
      the rotation's yaw 该朝向的偏航角

    • setPitch

      public void setPitch(float pitch)
      Sets the pitch of this location, measured in degrees. 设置此位置的俯仰角（pitch），以度为单位。
      • A pitch of 0 represents level forward facing. 俯仰角 0 表示水平朝前。
      • A pitch of 90 represents downward facing, or negative y direction. 俯仰角 90 表示朝下，即负 y 方向。
      • A pitch of -90 represents upward facing, or positive y direction. 俯仰角 -90 表示朝上，即正 y 方向。
      Increasing pitch values the equivalent of looking down. 俯仰角增大相当于向下看。
      参数:
      pitch - new incline's pitch 新倾斜的俯仰角

    • getPitch

      public float getPitch()

      • A pitch of 90 represents downward facing, or negative y direction. 俯仰角 90 表示朝下，即负 y 方向。
      • A pitch of -90 represents upward facing, or positive y direction. 俯仰角 -90 表示朝上，即正 y 方向。

      the incline's pitch 该倾斜的俯仰角

    • length

      public double length()
      Gets the magnitude of the location, defined as sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2). The value of this method is not cached and uses a costly square-root function, so do not repeatedly call this method to get the location's magnitude. NaN will be returned if the inner result of the sqrt() function overflows, which will be caused if the length is too long. Not world-aware and orientation independent. 获取此位置的长度（模），定义为 sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2)。此方法的结果不会被缓存，且使用开销较高的平方根函数，因此不要反复调用此方法来获取位置的长度。若 sqrt() 函数的内部结果溢出（长度过长时会发生），将返回 NaN。不感知世界且与朝向无关。
      返回:
      the magnitude 长度（模）
      另请参阅:
      • Vector

    • distance

      public double distance(Location o)
      Get the distance between this location and another. The value of this method is not cached and uses a costly square-root function, so do not repeatedly call this method to get the location's magnitude. NaN will be returned if the inner result of the sqrt() function overflows, which will be caused if the distance is too long. 获取此位置与另一位置之间的距离。此方法的结果不会被缓存，且使用开销较高的平方根函数，因此不要反复调用此方法来获取位置的长度。若 sqrt() 函数的内部结果溢出（距离过长时会发生），将返回 NaN。
      参数:
      o - The other location 另一个位置
      返回:
      the distance 距离
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - for differing worlds 如果两位置所在世界不同
      另请参阅:
      • Vector
